com.vector.cfg.dom.runtimesys.groovy.api

Interface IComponentPortSelection


  • @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public interface IComponentPortSelection
    IComponentPortSelection represents a selection of IComponentPorts and the possible operations on these component ports.

      • autoMap

        @PublishedMethod

      • autoMapTo

        @PublishedMethod
<T extends IConnector> java.util.List<T> autoMapTo(@Nonnull @VDelegatesToWithClosureParam(value=IComponentPortAutoMapper.class)
                                                                     groovy.lang.Closure<?> code)
        autoMapTo(Closure) tries to auto-map the selection of component ports according the component connection assistant rules but offers more control for the auto-mapping: Inside the closure additional predicates for narrowing down the target component ports can be defined and code to evaluate and change the auto-mapper results can be provided.

        Narrowing down the target component ports may be useful to gain better matches for the auto-mapper: In case several target component ports match equally, no auto-mapping is performed. So reducing the target component ports may improve the results of the auto-mapping.

        The component port selection will produce trace, info and warning logs. To see them, activate the 'IComponentPortSelection' logger with the appropriate log level.

        Parameters:
        code - The code to provide target predicates or evaluate the matches.
        Returns:
        A list of created connectors (mappings).

      • createDelegationPorts

        @PublishedMethod
java.util.List<IComponentPort> createDelegationPorts(@Nonnull @VDelegatesToWithClosureParam(value=IDelegationPortCreator.class)
                                                                       groovy.lang.Closure<?> createDelegationPortCode)

        createDelegationPorts(Closure) creates a delegation port for each selected component port using their port interfaces.
        If the naming is not specified, the names of the created delegation ports are derived from the port interfaces. The direction of the ports has to be specified.

        Creating new delegation ports is currently restricted to sender/receiver, client/server and trigger ports.

        Returns:
        A list of the newly created delegation component ports.

      • removePortTerminators

        @PublishedMethod
java.util.Collection<IComponentPort> removePortTerminators()
        removePortTerminators() removes the port terminators of all selected component ports. If one of the selected component ports is not terminated the method will ignore that port.

        See terminate() for more information about the purpose of terminating ports.

        Returns:
        A collection containing all selected component ports for which a port terminator has been removed.

      • terminate

        @PublishedMethod
java.util.Collection<IComponentPort> terminate()
        terminate() terminates all selected IComponentPorts. If one of the selected ports is already terminated or connected to another component port, the port will be ignored.

        The termination of component ports disables the validation of these ports. In other words, these ports are acknowledged as not connected yet. This should give a better overview of the open ports, which still have to be connected or need a data mapping.

        Returns:
        A collection containing all selected component ports which were terminated by this call.

      • unmap

        @PublishedMethod
java.util.Collection<IUnmappedPortsResult> unmap()
        unmap() unmaps the selected component ports of this selection from ALL connected ports. In case that not all connections shall be removed the targets can be narrowed down using unmapFrom(Closure).
        Returns:
        A collection of IUnmappedPortsResults representing the IComponentPorts of each removed IConnector.
        That means also in case a selected component port was disconnected from multiple target ports, for each disconnected target port exactly one IUnmappedPortsResult.

      • unmapFrom

        @PublishedMethod
java.util.Collection<IUnmappedPortsResult> unmapFrom(@Nonnull @VDelegatesToWithClosureParam(value=IComponentPortUnmapper.class)
                                                                       groovy.lang.Closure<?> code)
        #unmapFrom() unmaps the selected component ports of this selection from the connected ports. In opposite to unmap() this method allows additional evaluation of the component port pairs that should be unmapped.
        Returns:
        A collection of IUnmappedPortsResults representing the IComponentPorts of each removed IConnector.
        That means also in case a selected component port was disconnected from multiple target ports, for each disconnected target port exactly one IUnmappedPortsResult.
